page.overview:
What is Fornhala?

Fornhala is an abandoned village located in the middle of Ard Skellig. Its inhabitants fled the area for unknown reasons, although it is widely known that the locals were worshiping the banished god Svalblod. The Vildkaarls are said to roam here.

There is a large cave in this village, the entrance to which is in the southeast house. Presumably, the cave was once used for rituals.
